sentences.text: Man of Steel is a 2013 superhero film featuring the DC Comics character Superman .	superhero film	superhero film	DC Comics	DC Comics	Superman	Superman

It is a British-American venture produced by Legendary Pictures , DC Entertainment , Syncopy Inc. , and Cruel and Unusual Films , and distributed by Warner Bros. .	DC Entertainment	DC Entertainment	Legendary Pictures	Legendary Pictures	Syncopy	Syncopy Inc.	Cruel and Unusual Films	Cruel and Unusual Films
It is the first installment in the DC Extended Universe .	DC Extended Universe	DC Extended Universe

The film is directed by Zack Snyder , written by David S. Goyer , and stars Henry Cavill , Amy Adams , Michael Shannon , Kevin Costner , Diane Lane , Laurence Fishburne , Antje Traue , Ayelet Zurer , Christopher Meloni , and Russell Crowe .	Zack Snyder	Zack Snyder	David S. Goyer	David S. Goyer	Henry Cavill	Henry Cavill	Amy Adams	Amy Adams	Michael Shannon	Michael Shannon	Kevin Costner	Kevin Costner	Diane Lane	Diane Lane	Laurence Fishburne	Laurence Fishburne	Antje Traue	Antje Traue	Ayelet Zurer	Ayelet Zurer	Christopher Meloni	Christopher Meloni	Russell Crowe	Russell Crowe
Man of Steel is a reboot of the Superman film series that retells the character 's origin story .	Superman	Superman	reboot	Reboot (fiction)	origin story	Origin of Superman

In the film , Clark Kent learns that he is a superpowered alien from the planet Krypton and assumes the role of mankind 's protector as Superman , but finds himself having to prevent General Zod from destroying humanity .	Superman	Superman	Clark Kent	Clark Kent	Krypton	Krypton (comics)	General Zod	General Zod
Development began in 2008 , when Warner Bros. took pitches from comic book writers , screenwriters and directors , opting to reboot the franchise .	reboot	Reboot (fiction)	directors	film director
In 2009 , a court ruling resulted in Jerry Siegel 's family recapturing the rights to Superman 's origins and Siegel 's copyright .	Superman	Superman	Jerry Siegel	Jerry Siegel

The decision stated that Warner Bros. did not owe the families additional royalties from previous films , but if they did not begin production on a Superman film by 2011 , then the Shuster and Siegel estates would be able to sue for lost revenue on an unproduced film .	Superman	Superman

Producer Christopher Nolan pitched Goyer 's idea after story discussion on The Dark Knight Rises , and Snyder was hired as the film 's director in October 2010 .	Christopher Nolan	Christopher Nolan	The Dark Knight Rises	The Dark Knight Rises
Principal photography began in August 2011 in West Chicago , Illinois , before moving to Vancouver and Plano , Illinois .	Principal photography	Principal photography	Vancouver	Vancouver
Man of Steel was released in theaters on June 14 , 2013 , in conventional 2D , 3D , and IMAX formats .	IMAX	IMAX
Despite receiving mixed reviews , the film became a box office success , grossing over $ 668 million worldwide .
Critics praised the film 's visuals , action sequences , and Hans Zimmer 's musical score but criticized its pacing and lack of character development .	Hans Zimmer	Hans Zimmer
A follow-up , Batman v Superman : Dawn of Justice was released on March 25 , 2016 while a standalone Superman sequel is in active development .	Superman	Superman	follow-up	Sequel
